title: Rory and the Silver Moss Valley
verses:
The moon had arisen above the dark trees,
When Psittaco chirped from a moss-covered nest.
High up in the air flew sweet Nia with ease,
To lead all her friends to a valley of rest.

The moss was as soft as a pillow of green,
Beside a clear stream where the water rolled slow.
Sweet Tilly stepped down with a smile so serene,
As Benny sank deep in the shadows below.

Sturdy Ricky stretched out on a carpet of blue,
And rested his chin on his heavy front paw.
Tiny Psittaco snuggled in leaves wet with dew,
With feelings of comfort and magical awe.

Big Rory curled up with a sleepy green tail,
He yawned at the stars as they started to gleam.
A soft silvery light drifted down on the vale,
To carry the friends on a whispering dream.

The night-crickets sang in a quiet refrain,
While Nia tucked wings on a warm rocky ledge.
No shadow or worry was left to remain,
Safe out on the quiet and velvety edge.

So hush now, sweet child, while the silver stars keep
Their watch on the world in a magical glow.
For now it is time to fall softly asleep,
Where peaceful and beautiful dream-rivers flow.
